description: Rust foundation crates: avb-core (std-only primitives, design §6.1/§5.1) and avb-dext (ABI v3 mirror + IOKit Device moved from avb-probe + shared-memory ring consumer), and migrate avb-probe to re-export them with ABI v3. Depends on FEAT-001 (the Rust literals must equal the C++ static_asserts).
steps: Create crates/avb-core (lib avb_core, no third-party deps, #![deny(clippy::indexing_slicing)]): MacAddr, Eui64 (from MAC with FF:FE inserted), StreamId, EthFrame/VLAN parse+build (at most one tag; Result<_, DropReason>), MachTicks(u64) newtype, Timebase{numer,denom} conversions (no mach calls), GptpNs, ext32 (32->64 extension within +-2^31 of a reference), SeqLock<T: SeqWords<N>, N> over seq: AtomicU32 + [AtomicU64; N] with the §5.1 writer/reader protocol and 1000-retry Err(Contended), Outbox<const N> (push -> Result<(), TxFull>, drop-new), is_avdecc_dest(mac, our_mac), Now{mach, gptp: Option}, RxMeta, DropReason, counter helpers. Tests: ext32 wrap, EUI-64, VLAN parse, SeqLock concurrent no-tear + Contended against a writer held odd, is_avdecc_dest with the exact boundary MACs from the dext test, Timebase 125/3 and 1/1.

Create crates/avb-dext (lib avb_dext; deps anyhow =1.0.104, io-kit-sys =0.5.0, core-foundation-sys =0.8.7, mach2 =0.7.0): git mv crates/avb-probe/src/{abi.rs,iokit.rs,nic.rs,freq.rs} into crates/avb-dext/src/ (nic.rs depends on freq.rs and iokit.rs depends on nic.rs, so they move together). abi.rs: ABI_VERSION 3, sel 10-14 + COUNT 15 + BASE_COUNT 10, mem types, new flags, all SHM/RX constants, RxClass, RXF_* (TS_STEP_AMBIG = 8), STEP_SETTLE_NS 1_000_000, #[repr(C)] RxSlot, Counters, ShmHeader, ShmConsumer, StreamFilter(Entry), counter index consts + names, fn class_counter_index(cls) -> usize { cls as usize } with const asserts Gptp->1, Stream->6; offset_of!/size_of tests for every §3.1 literal (slot clock_gen 40, pad1 44, header clock_gen 896, reserved 900, ctl_head 128, audio_head 256, counters 384, RX mem 17_842_176).

avb-dext iokit.rs: add Device::open_i210(), step_clock(delta)->(before,after,mach_mid), get_counters(), set_stream_filter(&StreamFilter), ring_attach(flags)->(generation, rx_size, consumer_size), ring_detach(), map_memory(type)/unmap via IOConnectMapMemory64/IOConnectUnmapMemory64 with kIOMapAnywhere, and a classify helper for device-removed IOReturns (kIOReturnNoDevice/NotResponding/NotAttached/MACH_SEND_INVALID_DEST) used by the daemon for exit 7. Keep the ABI check on open (now v3).

avb-dext shm.rs: RxRings over a raw mapping (and over a heap buffer for tests): validate_header(hdr, generation) -> Result<(), LayoutMismatch> (every field vs compiled constants), acquire loads of heads/live fields via &*(p as *const AtomicU64/AtomicU32), RxSlotRef (bounds-checked view: len<=1984, cls in range, not both VLAN flags, clock_gen not ahead of hdr.clock_gen -> slot_gen_invalid), ConsumerTails with release stores, consumer loop helper that checks slot.index == tail and on mismatch reports desync and jumps tail to head. Tests over a heap buffer: header accept/reject per field, wrap at the ring size, desync jump, slot validation rejects.

crates/avb-probe: Cargo.toml adds avb-dext path dep; src/lib.rs replaces `pub mod abi; pub mod iokit; pub mod nic; pub mod freq;` with `pub use avb_dext::{abi, freq, iokit, nic};` so main.rs/ptp.rs/stats.rs paths are unchanged. Probe commands keep working via legacy PollRx; no command is retired (DP-12). Add a `counters` subcommand (GetCounters, read-only) used by M0, printing names from avb_dext counter names.
Add both crates to Cargo.toml [workspace].members; update Cargo.lock offline (cargo build --offline once), then everything uses --locked.
Append FEAT-002 to /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/.agents/tasks/phase1a-impl-verification.md; commit 'feat(rust): avb-core, avb-dext ABI v3 mirror, probe migration (phase1a FEAT-002)'.
acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p avb-core -p avb-dext -p avb-probe --locked passes, including every ABI offset/size literal from design §3.1
avb-probe builds with its existing commands unchanged plus `counters`; its existing 27 tests still pass (they move with their modules if abi/freq/nic tests lived there)
avb-core has no third-party dependency (cargo tree -p avb-core shows only itself)
Cargo.lock changes only add internal crates/edges; no new external versions
findings: avb-core (crate avb_core, std only, #![deny(clippy::indexing_slicing)]; re-exports at the root): MacAddr([u8;6]) {new, octets, is_multicast, from_slice, to_u64, from_u64, BROADCAST, Display aa:bb:..}; Eui64([u8;8]) {from_mac (FF:FE insert), to_u64, from_u64}; StreamId(u64) {from_parts(mac, uid), mac, unique_id, to_be_bytes, from_be_bytes, Display 0x%016x}; mac::AVDECC_MULTICAST, is_avdecc_dest(mac: MacAddr, our_mac: MacAddr) -> bool. eth: EthHeader {dst, src, vlan: Option<VlanTag>, ethertype} with len(), encode(&mut [u8]) -> Option<usize>, encode_frame(payload, out) -> Option<usize>; VlanTag {pcp, dei, vid} from_tci/tci; EthFrame<'a> {hdr, vlan_source: VlanSource{None,InFrame,Descriptor}, payload} via EthFrame::parse(&[u8]) or parse_with_desc_vlan(frame, desc_tci: Option<u16>) -> Result<_, DropReason> (TooShort; inner 0x8100/0x88A8 -> Malformed; in-frame tag wins); consts ETH_HDR_LEN, VLAN_TAG_LEN, ETHERTYPE_VLAN, ETHERTYPE_QINQ. time: MachTicks(u64) {add_ticks, ticks_since}; Timebase {numer, denom} {IDENTITY, is_valid, ticks_to_ns, ns_to_ticks (both floor, saturating, 0 if invalid), delta_ns(from, to) -> i64, ticks_to_ns_f64}; GptpNs(u64) {from_secs_nanos -> Option, secs, subsec_nanos, delta_ns, NS_PER_SEC}; ext32(reference: u64, low: u32) -> Option<u64> (nearest within [ref-2^31, ref+2^31), None below 0 / above u64::MAX). seqlock: trait SeqWords<const N>: Copy {to_words, from_words}; SeqLock<T: SeqWords<N>, const N> {new(T), write(&self, T) single writer, read(&self) -> Result<T, Contended>}; seqlock::MAX_RETRIES = 1000; free fns seqlock::write_words(seq: &AtomicU32, words: &[AtomicU64], vals: &[u64]) and read_words(seq, words, out: &mut [u64]) -> Result<(), Contended> for shared-memory blocks (avb-audioring §10.6 should use these). outbox: TxFrame (fixed 1514 B buffer; pub want_ts: bool, pub tag: u64; from_bytes(bytes, want_ts, tag), build(&EthHeader, payload, want_ts, tag) -> Result<_, FrameTooLong>, bytes(), len()); outbox::TX_FRAME_MAX = 1514; Outbox<const N> {new() const, push(TxFrame) -> Result<(), TxFull> drop-new, front() (leave in place on Busy/NoResources), pop(), len, is_empty, is_full, capacity, clear, iter}. TxFrame is ~1.5 KB, so Outbox<40> is ~61 KB: box it or keep it in a long-lived struct. rx: Now {mach: MachTicks, gptp: Option<GptpNs>} (+ Now::mach_only); RxMeta {harvest: MachTicks, hw_ts: Option<u64> SYSTIM ns, clock_gen: u32, step_ambig: bool, desc_vlan_tci: Option<u16>, loopback: bool}; DropReason {TooShort, Malformed, WrongEtherType, WrongDestination, Unsupported, NotForUs, OwnFrame, Stale, StepAmbiguous, OutOfRange} with name() snake_case (add variants if a later crate needs one). counter: Counter (relaxed AtomicU64: new const, inc, add, get, set, set_max), counter::bump(&mut u64). avb-dext (crate avb_dext; modules abi, freq, iokit, nic, shm; avb-probe re-exports abi/freq/iokit/nic so its paths are unchanged). abi: ABI_VERSION 3; sel::{GET_INFO..SHUTDOWN_DATAPATH, STEP_CLOCK 10, GET_COUNTERS 11, SET_STREAM_FILTER 12, RING_ATTACH 13, RING_DETACH 14, COUNT 15, BASE_COUNT 10}; mem::{RX 1, CONSUMER 2} (u32 memoryType); FLAG_RINGS_ATTACHED 0x20, FLAG_OWNED 0x40 (plus existing FLAG_LINK_UP etc., STAGE_*, fault_name, stage_name, tx_status_name, TX_TS_*); SHM_MAGIC, SHM_HEADER_SIZE, RX_SLOT_SIZE, RX_SLOT_HDR, RX_SLOT_DATA_MAX, RX_CTL_SLOTS, RX_AUDIO_SLOTS, RX_CTL_OFFSET, RX_AUDIO_OFFSET, RX_MEM_SIZE, CONSUMER_MEM_SIZE, MAX_STREAMS (all u32), STEP_CLOCK_MAX_NS i64, TX_RATE_PER_SEC, TX_BURST; RxClass #[repr(u8)] {None..Stream} with from_u8/name, RX_CLASS_COUNT; RXF_TS_HW/RXF_VLAN_FRAME/RXF_VLAN_DESC/RXF_TS_STEP_AMBIG (u16), STEP_SETTLE_NS u32; repr(C) RxSlot, Counters {c: [u64; 64]} with get(i), ShmHeader (+ ShmHeader::expected(generation)), ShmConsumer, StreamFilterEntry {dest_mac, vid}, StreamFilter {count, pad, e} with from_entries(&[Entry]) -> Option, entries(), is_valid() (dext rule); ctr::* indices (RX_FRAMES 0 .. RX_OVERSIZE 33, COUNT 64), COUNTER_NAMES [(usize, &str); 33], counter_name(i), class_counter_index(cls) -> usize (const fn). iokit::Device methods relevant to DextPort: open(NicSelect)/open_i210(), profile(), info() (checks ABI 3), read_clock(n) -> Vec<ClockSample>, set_clock(ns) -> readback, adj_freq(ppb) -> raw reg, step_clock(delta_ns: i64) -> (before_ns, after_ns, mach_mid) (rejects |delta| > 1e9 client-side), init_datapath(flags) -> stage, shutdown_datapath(), poll_rx (legacy), send_frame(&[u8], want_ts) -> (tx_seq, mach_at_doorbell), get_tx_timestamp(seq) -> (status, hw_ts, mach_latched), read_reg32, get_counters() -> Box<Counters>, set_stream_filter(&StreamFilter), ring_attach(flags) -> (generation, rx_mem_size, consumer_mem_size) as u64s, ring_detach(), map_memory(mem_type: u32) -> MemMap {mem_type(), as_ptr() -> *mut u8, len()}, unmap_memory(MemMap) (explicit, consumes; no Drop unmap, so follow the §5.3 order). Device is not Clone; Drop closes the connection. Errors: every failed call is anyhow::Error wrapping iokit::IoReturnError {what, kr: u32}; use iokit::io_return_of(&err) -> Option<u32>, iokit::is_device_removed(&err) / is_device_removed_kr(kr) (NoDevice 0xe00002c0, NotResponding 0xe00002ed, NotAttached 0xe00002d9, MACH_SEND_INVALID_DEST 0x10000003 -> exit 7), constants iokit::kr::{EXCLUSIVE_ACCESS (exit 10), BUSY, NO_RESOURCES (TX retry), NOT_READY, NOT_PERMITTED, ...}, kr_name(kr). shm: validate_header(&ShmHeader, generation: u64) -> Result<(), LayoutMismatch {field, expected, found}>; Ring {Ctl, Audio} with slots()/name(); RxRings<'m>: unsafe from_raw(rx_ptr, rx_len, consumer_ptr, consumer_len) -> Result<_, LayoutMismatch> (sizes + 8-byte alignment; reads current tails), validate(generation), live acquire loads generation()/stage()/fault()/flags()/producer_running() -> bool/last_tick_mach()/clock_gen()/head(ring), mac(), tail(ring), counter(i)/counters() relaxed, and drain(&mut self, ring, max, |Result<RxSlotRef<'_>, SlotError>|) -> DrainReport {delivered, invalid, desync: Option<Desync {ring, tail, head, found_index: Option<u64>}>}. drain checks slot.index == tail (mismatch -> desync, tail jumps to head) and head-tail <= slots, validates each slot against the header clock_gen read after the head, and release-stores the tail once after the callbacks. RxRings is Send, not Sync. RxSlotRef<'a>: validate(&RxSlot, header_clock_gen) (len <= 1984, cls 1..=6, not both VLAN flags, clock_gen not ahead with wrapping compare), index, cls() -> RxClass, data() -> &[u8], hw_ts() -> Option<u64>, harvest_mach, clock_gen, step_ambig, desc_vlan_tci() -> Option<u16>, vlan_in_frame, flags, status_error, desc_len, raw(). SlotError {BadLen, BadClass, BothVlanFlags, GenAhead{slot, header}} with counter_name() ('slot_gen_invalid' for GenAhead, else 'slot_invalid'). ConsumerTails (inside RxRings) holds a local copy of each tail and release-stores. HeapRxMem (public, for tests and the daemon's FakeDext): new(generation) writes ShmHeader::expected, header_mut(), rings() -> RxRings<'_>, produce(ring, &RxSlot) -> bool (dext rule: drop-newest, index = head, release head+1), write_slot, set_head, set_clock_gen, head, consumer_tail. Allocates about 17.8 MB. avb-probe: new read-only `counters` subcommand (GetCounters, prints COUNTER_NAMES with values, --json key 'counters'); all other commands unchanged; ClockSample JSON via a local ClockSampleJson (same fields). Not yet run against hardware (M0). Cargo: workspace members now avb-core, avb-dext, avb-installer, avb-probe; Cargo.lock +15 lines (2 internal packages, 1 new internal edge). avb-dext has no serde, so later crates that need serde for ABI types must wrap them.
